title: LLM hallucinations in the wild: Large-scale evidence from non-existent citations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the prior publication counts and citation impact of authors credited in LLM-hallucinated citations against a matched sample of real citations to determine if highly productive or impactful authors are disproportionately favored.
Comparing the proportion of male-named authors credited in hallucinated citations relative to a matched sample of real citations from the same month and field.
Analyzing team size and established author-ordering conventions (specifically the productivity/impact hierarchy between first and last authors) in hallucinated citations compared to real citations.
